span.p:
Visitor types into the
search box

div.style: color: rgb(15, 17, 17) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Tidy up the words: ignore capitals,
punctuation and filler words
like 'the' or 'how'

div.style: color: rgb(15, 17, 17) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Give every page and section
a score for how well it matches

div.style: color: rgb(15, 17, 17) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Show up to 8 of the best matches
in a list under the box,
updating with every letter

div.style: color: rgb(15, 17, 17) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Did they pick one
from the list?

div.style: color: rgb(15, 17, 17) !important; font-weight: bold !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Take them to the page
or section they picked

span.p:
Say there are no results
and suggest other words

div.style: color: rgb(15, 17, 17) !important; font-weight: bold !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Take them straight to the
best-scoring page

div.style: color: rgb(15, 17, 17) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

p.br:
exact title match: top score
word in the title: more points
word in its keywords: some points
part of a word, like 'eng': a few points

div.style: color: rgb(15, 17, 17) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center; width: 340px;

span.p:
What was typed is counted for the team's
analytics page, with no name or IP address.
